title: Effect of Cooling Therapy for Post-Operative Pain in Open Carpal Tunnel Release
official: Effect of Cooling Therapy for Post-Operative Pain in Open Carpal Tunnel Release
summary: This study seeks to perform an appropriately-powered study to evaluate any clinical difference between continuous cooling therapy and traditional ice for treatment of post-operative pain in open CTR surgery.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age 18 or older
2. Indicated for open carpal tunnel release
3. Able and willing to complete online questionnaires

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Prior carpal tunnel surgery for ipsilateral extremity
2. Additional procedures to be performed on ipsilateral or contralateral extremity
3. Current opioid or narcotic pain medication usage
